question: What Is an Inter Discipline Check (IDC) in Engineering?
body_html:
An inter discipline check (IDC) is a formal design review where each engineering discipline checks its documents against every other discipline's before drawings are issued for construction:

DisciplineMain Items Reviewed
ProcessP&ID, connection sizes, signal types
MechanicalVendor packages, PLC and HMI, panels
Piping3D model, instrument connections, tray routing
Civil and structuralWall and floor cutouts for cable routes
ElectricalLoad list, I/O lists, cable trays, earth pits
